input: Set up a tip pool agreement for my small cafe staff

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Tip Pool Agreement for Cafe Staff
gold.taskDescription: Create a formal tip pooling agreement tailored to the user's small cafe, covering how tips are collected, distributed, and agreed upon by all staff.

questions.title: Which staff roles will be included in the tip pool?
questions.description: Identify which positions (e.g., servers, baristas, bussers, kitchen staff) are eligible to participate in the tip pool.

questions.title: How many employees will this agreement cover?
questions.description: Determine the total number of staff members who will be part of the tip pool arrangement.

questions.title: What is the tip distribution method you have in mind?
questions.description: Clarify whether tips will be split equally, by hours worked, by role weight, or by another formula.

questions.title: How often will tips be distributed to staff?
questions.description: Establish the payout frequency, such as daily at end of shift, weekly, or on paydays.

questions.title: Does your cafe collect both cash and card tips?
questions.description: Understand the tip sources involved, as card tips and cash tips may need to be tracked and pooled differently.

questions.title: What country or state is your cafe located in?
questions.description: Determine the applicable labor laws and regulations that govern tip pooling in the user's jurisdiction.

questions.title: Do you want staff to formally sign the agreement?
questions.description: Decide whether the agreement needs to be a signed document for legal acknowledgment or is an internal policy only.
